about: The Workbench icons of the GNUjump drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is the game's own hero (skins/default/hero1.1.png). Each drawer inside skins (a skin, its cursor and heroanim drawers) gets a copy of GNUjump.info, which has no place of its own, so Workbench places it.
